# Colourful Saddles
Have you ever wanted colourful dyed saddles in your Minecraft world? Then this pack is _sort of_ for you!

## "Dyed" Saddles
This pack adds functionality for "dyed" horse saddles. It comes with 17 colours, one for a new brown-er base saddle and 16 colours based on the existing base dyes in Minecraft! It also adds corresponding custom coloured saddle item textures.

As of version 1.1 the pack now supports ALL saddle-able mobs!

## How it works...
Just place a normal saddle into an anvil, and rename it as "<Colour> Saddle". You'll see the saddle turn the correct colour and when you place it on your animal of choice, you'll see your chosen coloured saddle!

(The pack uses British English spelling so remember to spell it "Grey" and not "Gray")


![Visual explanation of the renaming process](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/662549e5f01a06ddcf981f7604551d63eac88856.png)

## Requirements
This pack requires: 
- [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)
- [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)

Or,
- Optifine
